summary: PREMIUM_PRACTICE_SESSION_RACE_FIX verified at 390x844 as an anonymous guest using the Spanish UI. Dedicated Listening (/listening-practice): loading screen, then lp-intro, with EXACTLY ONE GET /api/guests/{id}/listening-practice?free_only=true. All 5 items answered (counter 1/5 to 5/5). No extra requests during the session. 'Practicar de nuevo' sent exactly one new request and went straight to question 1/5 without the intro. Speaking (/speaking-practice): same results (sp-intro, one request with free_only=true, first speaking-question rendered, skipped through to sp-complete, 'again' sent one request and went to 1/5). Found and fixed a CRITICAL bug added in BillingContext: when RevenueCat fails, the catch block referenced `desiredId`, which only existed inside the try block. This threw an uncaught ReferenceError, which showed the CRA error overlay, and resolvedFor was never set. accessResolved stayed false, so the dedicated practice pages would stay on loading forever whenever RevenueCat is unreachable (outage, adblock, network). I reproduced it by blocking *revenuecat* requests in Playwright ('PAGEERROR desiredId is not defined'). After the fix, the same scenario shows lp-intro with one free_only=true request. Jest: 34/34 pass after the fix (11+23). Backend: 420/420 pass, run against localhost:8001 one file at a time with throttling. A full parallel run against the public URL triggered Cloudflare 429 'Just a moment' challenges, and localhost runs at full speed ran out of ephemeral ports (the container only has 1024). Home, Progress, Practice hub and the lesson /lesson/taking-a-drinks-order (intro, listening/speaking item endpoints) load with no console errors. Changing the language mid-session was NOT tested in the browser; only the jest tests cover it.

rca of the issue: Root cause: in BillingContext's identity useEffect, `const desiredId` was declared inside try{}, but the new catch line called setResolvedFor(desiredId). On any RevenueCat failure the catch threw a ReferenceError after setStatus('error'). resolvedFor stayed undefined !== null, so PracticeSessionPage.accessResolved was never true and no session was created (stuck on 'Cargando'). Repro: block *revenuecat* requests, then onboard and open Practice > Comprensión oral. Mitigation: hoist desiredId outside try (done) and verify again with RevenueCat blocked: lp-intro shows with exactly one free_only=true request.
